parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is the wheel of the cart, likely made of steel for durability and load-bearing capacity.
parts.Functional_description: The wheel allows the cart to roll smoothly and supports the weight of the load during movement.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle to enable forward and backward motion of the cart.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body or base of the cart, made of wood, forming the structure that holds the load.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the primary load-bearing platform and includes handles for pushing or pulling the cart.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to the wheel, providing structural support while the wheel rotates.
